pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate common ACP transport, AgentHost bridge, Claude/Codex/Goose adapters
- route first-class AI Studio agent Ask and Build plus normal Managed Local sessions through ACP
- make Goose ACP Agent Harness the normal/recommended Managed Local Benchmark Campaign path
- expose an explicit Runtime / Harness selector and freeze its provider-neutral ACP runtime identity through campaign, experiment, child, execution, and terminal record
- retain Legacy Native only as an explicit compatibility/comparison harness and fail closed instead of silently falling back from ACP
- reject ACP read-question and visual-evaluation evidence before execution while preserving validation-repair and runtime-aware AgentHost permission authority
- keep ACP-unobservable model turn/token telemetry unavailable
- keep legacy runtime-classification regression tests on an ACP-supported governed task

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is authoritative for the integrated head.
Editor Visual Validation covers the Benchmark Campaign Runtime / Harness selector and frozen identity summary.
